stories.title: Nobelprijs voor de Vrede gaat naar voormalig VN-mensenrechtenchef en ICC-rechter Navanethem Pillay

en.title: Peace Prize awarded to former UN human rights chief and ICC judge Navanethem Pillay
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. The jury recognized her work advancing peace and reshaping international law.

en.title: Former UN human rights chief Navanethem Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay, a former UN human rights chief, has won the Nobel Peace Prize.

stories.title: Voormalige ICC-rechter en VN-mensenrechtenchef Pillay wint Nobelprijs Vrede

en.title: Former ICC judge and UN human rights chief Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay, an 85-year-old South African former UN human rights chief and ICC judge, won the Nobel Peace Prize for her work on peace and international law.

stories.title: Vredesprijs voor Zuid-Afrikaanse mensenrechtenchef en ICC-rechter Navi Pillay

en.title: Peace Prize for South African human rights chief and ICC judge Navi Pillay
en.summary: South African judge Navi Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize for her efforts prosecuting perpetrators of war crimes and crimes against humanity, contributing significantly to international legal order.

stories.title: De Bondgenoten won Televizier-Ring met opvallend weinig stemmen

en.title: De Bondgenoten won Televizier-Ring with notably few votes
en.summary: De Bondgenoten won the Golden Televizier-Ring, the Netherlands' most prestigious television award, with 44 percent of votes. This represents an unusually low winning percentage in recent years.

stories.title: Wekdienst 9/10: Bekenmaking Nobelprijs voor de Vrede • Laatste dag inleveractie vuurwerk

en.title: News digest 9/10: Nobel Peace Prize announcement • Final day for anonymous fireworks surrender
en.summary: Today marks the final opportunity for anonymous fireworks disposal in the Netherlands and Oslo will announce the Nobel Peace Prize winner. Variable weather with rain expected, particularly in western and northern regions.

stories.title: SBS6-programma De Bondgenoten wint Gouden Televizier-Ring

en.title: SBS6 program De Bondgenoten wins Golden Television Ring
en.summary: The daily reality game show won the prestigious television award, defeating competitors Kassa and Woeste Grond. Presenter Jan Versteegh also received the Golden Television Ring for Best Presenter.

stories.title: Realityprogramma De Bondgenoten wint Gouden Televizier-Ring 2026

en.title: Reality program De Bondgenoten wins Golden Television Ring 2026
en.summary: The reality television program De Bondgenoten received the Golden Television Ring award for 2026.

stories.title: Dit zijn alle winnaars van het Gouden Televizier-Ring Gala 2026

en.title: These are all the winners of the Golden Television Ring Gala 2026
en.summary: Multiple awards were presented across various categories at the Golden Television Ring Gala held at the Royal Theatre Carré in Amsterdam, with NU.nl providing a complete list of all winners.

stories.title: Gouden Televizier-Ring voor De Bondgenoten, presentator Jan Versteegh wint ook

en.title: Golden Televizier-Ring awarded to De Bondgenoten, presenter Jan Versteegh also wins
en.summary: The SBS6 reality competition series De Bondgenoten won the Golden Televizier-Ring 2026, the Dutch viewer's choice award. Presenter Jan Versteegh also won the award for best presenter, while Annet Malherbe won best actor.

stories.title: Bondgenoten grote winnaar bij Gouden Televizier-Ring, ook Jan Versteegh wint

en.title: Bondgenoten major winner at Golden Televizier-Ring, Jan Versteegh also wins
en.summary: Reality program De Bondgenoten won the Golden Televizier-Ring award. Jan Versteegh won best presenter, Annet Malherbe won best actor, and Daan Alferink won the television talent award.

en.title: Live coverage | The Allies wins Golden Television Ring, Annet Malherbe best actor
en.summary: The 2026 Golden Television Ring Gala awards ceremony took place, with The Allies winning the main prize and Annet Malherbe receiving the best actor award.
